titulo: O ÁUDIO DA DESPEDIDA DE SOLTEIRA
personagens: Tania, a woman around 30 with a short curly afro and a yellow dress; her best friend, a woman around 30 with long straight black hair and a leather jacket; another friend around 29 with a blonde bun
cenario: a cozy apartment and a small intimate party
cenas: Tania listening to a voice message on her phone with earbuds, her expression turning hurt
Tania sitting on her bed listening to the audio again, two friends laughing in it
Tania replaying the clip, thinking her best friend wants to ruin her party
Tania comparing the recording with older messages on her laptop
Tania inviting the friends over to talk privately
The friends explaining they wanted to cancel an expensive attraction, embarrassed about their cruel tone
The best friend apologizing sincerely, holding Tania's hand
Tania calmly refusing the original party plan
Tania having a small budget-friendly bachelorette gathering with a few close friends at home
Tania laughing with her friends around a homemade cake and string lights
